name: auth-8
title: Centered Sign-Up Card
description: Sign-up card centered on the page with full name, email, and password fields, a terms checkbox, and Google and GitHub sign-up buttons.

standards.purpose: Collect the minimum needed to create an account and set expectations up front.
useWhen: A new user is creating an account.
doNotUseWhen: The user is signing in to an existing account.

rules.check: Ask only for what the account needs to function; extra profile data belongs in onboarding.
Password requirements are stated before submission and validated inline.
Terms and privacy acknowledgement is present and required where legally needed.
Every input carries a visible label or aria-label; a placeholder alone does not label a field.
